scope: Fresh independent source review of repaired permission Settings, shared helpers, dispatcher remedies, Tools badges, manifest declarations, and focused tests. No browser exercise or test run in this review lane.

verdict_a_runtime.reason: The admin Settings surface has not been exercised in a rebuilt Chrome extension from this review lane. Grant, refusal, removal, reload, and displayed browser status require live verification.

verdict_b_engineering_quality.reason: No important source regression found in the reviewed target. The shared manifest classifier drives both missing-grant remedies and Tools badges; required debugger and sessions grants are no longer described as optional switches. The focused test gate is running separately in the owner lane, so its result is not claimed here.

prior_findings.evidence: declaredRuntimeOptionalPermissions filters the Settings rows through runtime optional_permissions; the build config excludes unsupported capture permissions on Firefox and Safari, and the focused test covers an omitted pair.

prior_findings.finding: Refresh rejection can strand a switch busy
prior_findings.evidence: AdvancedAgentCapabilities.toggle clears busy in an outer finally; refresh catches a rejected status read and exposes Retry permission check. The test covers a rejected read followed by recovery.
debugger remains required in wxt.config.ts and has an informational Settings row without a switch. Both dispatcher paths call missingPermissionRemedy, which now uses classifyDeclaredPermissions.

prior_findings.finding: Required sessions permission receives optional-switch remedy
prior_findings.evidence: sessions is declared in required manifest permissions. classifyDeclaredPermissions maps it to required, and the remedy says it cannot be enabled in Settings; the focused helper test includes sessions.

prior_findings.finding: Focused permission test queries before asynchronous refresh completes
prior_findings.evidence: The initial Clipboard read queries in the affected tests now use await screen.findByText. Fresh test result belongs to the owner lane.

prior_findings.finding: Tools roster labels required debugger as optional
prior_findings.evidence: ToolsView calls permissionRequirementLabel on the handler requirements; the helper returns req-perm for required debugger and sessions, opt-perm for cookies, mixed perms for a mixed requirement, and unavailable for undeclared permissions.

verdict_b_engineering_quality.evidence_limit: No runtime Chrome proof and no independently executed focused test result.
